presentations.name: The Empty Grave
presentations.summary: An Ascian likely wears Zenos's body. Thancred is going into the Empire's western provinces, Y'shtola to Doma, and Alisaie holds the Rising Stones. Over the Burn, attackers bearing the insignia of the Emperor's personal guard shot down Alphinaud's airship on the prince's orders, and a masked Ascian hunter called Shadowhunter offered to lead him and Maxima out.

citations.title: Under the Moonlight — main scenario quest (4.3)
Emissary of the Dawn — main scenario quest (4.3)

presentations.name: The Empty Grave
presentations.summary: Alphinaud is missing in the Empire. Thancred returned from its provinces: the Empire is punishing its subjects, an Ascian wears Zenos's skin in plain sight, and the only words he caught on Alphinaud's linkpearl named the Burn. The Alliance has called a council on the Ascian threat, and Alisaie means to search the Burn for her brother.

citations.title: Emissary of the Dawn — main scenario quest (4.3)
Sisterly Act — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: The Empty Grave
presentations.summary: Alphinaud's airship came down over the Burn. You searched it with Alisaie, Y'shtola, Yugiri and Lord Hien, fighting through Allagan ruins, and found the wreck among dead men of the Emperor's own guard, who were fighting their own. With no sign of Alphinaud or Maxima, the search is left to Doma's shinobi.

citations.title: Feel the Burn — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: The Empty Grave
presentations.summary: Alphinaud is still missing, and Lord Hien believes Zenos, or whoever wears his face, broke Doma's agreement with the Empire. Lyse brought word that Ala Mhigo has joined the Eorzean Alliance and invited Hien to a leaders' meeting. Hien seeks an alliance of his own, and Y'shtola hopes an Allagan field generator in the Burn could shield Doma's skies.

citations.title: Feel the Burn — main scenario quest (4.4)
Shadows in the Empire — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: To power an Allagan barrier in the Burn against the Empire, Lord Hien took you and Y'shtola to the Azim Steppe, while Alisaie had the Ironworks overhaul the field generators. A Mol myth of a moon shard led to the pillars of the House of the Crooked Coin, but Cirina warned that the tribes who revere Nhaama would spurn any alliance if they were disturbed.

citations.title: Shadows in the Empire — main scenario quest (4.4)
A Power in Slumber — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: The pillars of the House of the Crooked Coin proved an Allagan device that could feed Lord Hien's barrier in the Burn. To win the devout Dotharl, you beat their khatun, Sadu, in single combat, despite Magnai of the Oronir's interruption, and both tribes pledged their allegiance. Cirina committed the Mol to Hien's alliance.

citations.title: The Will of the Moon — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: Y'shtola set aether flowing to the Burn again, though Hingashi and Sui-no-Sato rejected Lord Hien's alliance. At the Alliance's council in Ala Mhigo, Thancred proposed spreading word that a corpse walks in Zenos's place, until a voice called to the Scions' souls and he fell into a slumber no healer can explain. Urianger heard the voice too: the Scions were its target.

citations.title: The Call — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: The voice struck again, and Urianger and Y'shtola collapsed beside Thancred, so Alisaie will seek outside help. In Garlemald, Zenos's body is Elidibus's vessel, and Emperor Varis learned that his grandsire, Solus, is an Ascian who built the Empire to sow chaos. Alphinaud and Shadowhunter found rebels killed by a gas called Black Rose.

citations.title: Prelude in Violet — main scenario quest (4.4)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: Thancred, Y'shtola and Urianger lie insensible. Krile found their bodies sound but their souls gone, and in Matoya's cave the threads of their aether simply end, though death has not taken them. Alisaie counts it progress that their souls are still out there. Then Lyse sent word that Populares have defected to Ala Mhigo, and Maxima is among them.

citations.title: Prelude in Violet — main scenario quest (4.4)
Soul Searching — main scenario quest (4.5)

presentations.name: Allies and Sleepers
presentations.summary: Three Scions lie insensible, their souls taken. Maxima told Raubahn that Alphinaud is safe with an Ascian-hunting band led by Shadowhunter, that a new weapon has crushed a rebellion, and that the Empire is marching west. You and Alisaie took the news to Lord Hien, whose alliance has grown, and the Ironworks are ready to test his barrier in the Burn.

citations.title: Soul Searching — main scenario quest (4.5)
A Defector's Tidings — main scenario quest (4.5)

presentations.name: War on the Border
presentations.summary: Lord Hien raised Seiryu's Wall over the Burn, and Shadowhunter brought Alphinaud back in the same slumber as the others. Shadowhunter is Gaius, who has renounced the Black Wolf and the Empire to hunt Ascians. He destroyed a Black Rose plant whose orders bore Zenos's signature and whose incubators held young Emperor Solus, who told Varis the civil war was his design.

citations.title: Seiryu's Wall — main scenario quest (4.5)

presentations.name: War on the Border
presentations.summary: Alphinaud lies in the Scions' slumber, and Gaius hunts Ascians. At a parley on Ala Mhigo's border, where the Empire asked for you and a Scion, Emperor Varis declared his grandsire, the former emperor, an Ascian and called for the worlds to be rejoined in a new nation. The Alliance and Doma, joined in a concord, refused, and Varis ended the talks for war.

citations.title: Seiryu's Wall — main scenario quest (4.5)
Parley on the Front Lines — main scenario quest (4.5)

presentations.name: War on the Border
presentations.summary: After the failed parley, you and Alisaie fought with a Doman unit at the Ghimlyt Dark until the imperials retreated. Then the voice spoke of a Light that will expunge all life, and Alisaie fell into the same slumber, the fifth Scion lost to it. Raubahn can spare no one to seek a cure, and Zenos marches toward the border.

citations.title: Parley on the Front Lines — main scenario quest (4.5)
The Face of War — main scenario quest (4.5)

presentations.name: War on the Border
presentations.summary: Five Scions lie in a slumber no one can explain, and the Alliance is at war with the Empire. Maxima, who now shares what he knows with the Alliance, met you with Cid, who calls himself an imperial defector and pledges the Ironworks against the Empire. Raubahn has summoned you to Alliance Headquarters, and Cid will fly you there.

citations.title: The Face of War — main scenario quest (4.5)
A Brief Reprieve — main scenario quest (4.56)

presentations.name: War on the Border
presentations.summary: On Ala Mhigo's front, the Ascian wearing Zenos's face beat Lord Hien, Lyse and Yugiri and then struck you down. A hooded figure called to you, bidding you go to the Crystal Tower, and you woke in Ishgard, rescued by Estinien. Varis has withdrawn to Garlemald and readies Black Rose, and Tataru bids you find the sleeping Scions and bring them home.

citations.title: A Requiem for Heroes — main scenario quest (4.56)

presentations.name: Ala Mhigo
presentations.summary: A nation in Gyr Abania, newly freed from the Empire, whose last king, Theodoric, was called the mad king. At its first council the Qalyana summoned Lakshmi in the throne room; afterwards the envoys chose a government of representatives elected by the people, modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons, and Raubahn stays to help rebuild.
